# Data Source: identitynow_non_employee_source

Use this data source to look up a non-employee source by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_non_employee_source" "contractors" {
  name = "Contractors"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Non-employee source ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Non-employee source name. All non-employee sources are listed and matched by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `account_managers` (Set of String) IDs of the account managers.
- `approvers` (List of String) IDs of the approvers, in approval order.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the non-employee source.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `source_id` (String) ID of the source that backs the non-employee source.
